title: Vignette 2026-11-02: outline continuity without a switch; a configuration option only when we need more control

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content: Owner, 2026-11-02, answering Open Question 3 of RFC-001 Revision 12 (srs#991: an unconditional continuity rule, or an opt-in property per Composition): "yes. But lets record our rationale properly. We will review a configuration option if we find that we need more control later."

sections.name: source
sections.label: Source
sections.content: The owner, in conversation with Claude Code, 2026-11-02; recorded verbatim. Recorded as rfc-decision-11c13e69 in srs (proposed until the revision is accepted).
